subject: maths
question: A man travels from point A to point B at a speed of 40 km/h and returns to point A at a speed of 60 km/h. If the total time taken for the journey is 5 hours, what is the distance between point A and point B?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For equal distance journeys, Distance = [ (S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂) ] × Total Time

Distance = [ (40 × 60) ÷ (40 + 60) ] × 5

Distance = [ 2400 ÷ 100 ] × 5

Distance = 24 × 5 = 120 km

**∴ The correct answer is 120 km.**
